extracted.name: Cucumber Salad with Herb & Garlic Dressing (Vinaigrette)
extracted.description: Recipe video above. Crisp, juicy cucumber and a tasty Herb & Garlic Vinaigrette makes for a sensational salad!! It's refreshing with extra flavour from the dressing - I can eat SO MUCH of this!! A touch of mustard is key here - thickens the dressing to help it coat the cucumber slices.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 tsp salt and black pepper (, EACH)
instruction_lines: Cucumber: Trim ends then slice about 3 mm/ 1/8" thick.
Place in bowl with red onion.
Pour over Dressing, toss gently and serve immediately.
